title: Recompose Main Display into a compact weather band and dominant clock zone
verify: Before any production write, capture fresh task-scoped RED at exactly 2460x1080 and 1280x720 from deterministic Main Display host render. Record raw screen/card/clock/icon/temperature/control bounds, band_ratio, clock_zone_ratio, card-height spread, bottom-alignment spread, horizontal regions and current state matrix. Do not promote W31 physical evidence to W32 RED.

Implement only the bounded Main Display composition correction in DisplayCapability.kt with focused DisplayProjectionTest.kt support: weather-card band 25-30% of total frame height, remaining clock zone 70-75%, equal-height/bottom-aligned four-card shell, city/date above Yesterday, complete maximum-fit HH:mm in the central/upper region, secondary weather illustrations, and separate right timer rail.

Obtain claim-equivalent GREEN at both sizes using the same deterministic host path. Record raw complete-HH:mm bounds against the available central/upper region and require the clock to be maximum-fit there, with no clipping, overlap or missing digit; do not apply an unaccepted clock-size ratio as a gate.

Prove the four ordered yesterday/today/tomorrow/day_after shells remain visible and macro-stable in NO_DATA, partial/async and populated redacted-fixture states. Preserve Weather Context read-only consumption and do not synthesize weather values.

Prove the three existing timer controls remain separate circular transparent controls with one-color preset radial neon rim/glow, existing order/labels/colors/selection/touch behavior and visible spacing; record raw bounds/gaps without imposing an unaccepted gap value. Timer & Alert semantics remain read-only.

Apply the named visual-QA rubric in main-display-presentation.md to both sizes, recording raw geometry plus qualitative/relational PASS/FAIL claims, any declared raster measurement tolerance and artifact locator for every macro claim. Run all five project-native gates and record host/device separation.

Build may complete for handoff, but the route MUST stop immediately before adb install/upload. Do not run adb, install an APK, launch a device/emulator, use network/credentials, or claim physical/runtime PASS until the operator separately releases the upload pause.

purpose: Correct the proven macro Main Display regression by making weather cards a compact 25-30% bottom band and reserving 70-75% for the dominant maximum-fit HH:mm clock, while preserving side columns, timer presentation and all Weather Context/Timer & Alert ownership.
success_outcome: Fresh host RED/GREEN at 2460x1080 and 1280x720 proves the compact equal-height bottom weather band, 70-75% clock zone, contained maximum-fit HH:mm, secondary illustrations, left city/date placement, separate right timer rail and stable four-slot states; all five host gates pass, physical install/runtime evidence is DEFERRED at the upload pause, and no neighbor behavior or historical task state changes.
anti_goals: Do not reopen, rewrite or change TASK-032 W29, TASK-033 W30 or TASK-034 W31 identity, lifecycle, evidence, protocols, scheduler checkpoint or terminal history.

Do not modify Weather Context, provider/adapters, cache/history/freshness/normalized data, weather semantics, Timer & Alert lifecycle/countdown/cancellation/overdue/audio, Android runtime ownership, MainActivity, resources, assets, dependencies, public contracts or graph edges.
Do not preserve a taller Yesterday card; do not allow any card to exceed the equal-height band tolerance; do not let weather illustrations dominate a card or the clock.
Do not introduce fixed device dp, font, asset, gradient-stop or single-resolution targets. If accepted ratios cannot be met without a new product choice, stop and route to /feature-doctor FT-001.
Do not run adb, adb install, emulator/AVD/QEMU, device launch, network, credentials or APK upload in the paused route.

The correction requires Weather Context, Timer & Alert, Android Runtime, resources, MainActivity, a new module/edge/public contract or another owner; stop and route to /spec-design or owning feature.

After host build/gates and planning handoff are complete, stop immediately before adb install/upload. No adb, APK install, emulator/device launch, lifecycle change or runtime evidence is allowed until separately authorized.
Any production/test write leaves the two exact boundary files, or any historical task, scheduler checkpoint, lifecycle/status or terminal state would change.

constraints: Main Display owns only shell composition/presentation; it consumes Weather Context and Timer & Alert projections/commands and never writes neighbor state.

The task-owned feature claim is FT-001-AC-002. REQ-001 constrains landscape/fullscreen policy, REQ-002 constrains the 25-30% band, 70-75% clock zone and complete clock, REQ-005 constrains ordered weather cards/equal shell height, and REQ-023 constrains readability/lightweight visuals.

Use only the accepted band/clock ratios as product gates and record raw geometry for the relational rules; the declared raster measurement tolerance is not a product target. Do not introduce fixed dp/font targets or a single-device pixel solution.

The left info column, central clock hero, bottom four-card row and right timer rail must remain distinct; city/date stays above Yesterday; timer controls remain circular, transparent, spaced and one-color radial.

Weather Context remains the sole owner of provider refresh, normalization, cache/history, freshness and weather-specific presentation; Timer & Alert remains the sole owner of timer lifecycle, countdown, cancellation, overdue and audio.
The operator upload pause is a hard stop immediately before adb install; physical/device/runtime evidence is DEFERRED in this task route.
